expectation: Membrane PDL1 on a minority of cells: macrophages and dendritic cells (CD14+), plus tumour cells in some cancers. Scattered or clustered in myeloid-rich stroma and tumour edges, and mostly absent from other cells.
observed: A: yellow haze in most cores, strongest in a few, tracking tissue density. B and C: diffuse yellow with a few saturated blobs and some stromal-band enrichment. D: smeared signal, no clear rings. E: PDL1 is broad haze, with partial white overlap on CD14 cells in E3 and much green on CD14-negative tissue.
why: Some enrichment on CD14-rich areas and stromal bands, but high diffuse background and little single-cell membrane definition lower the contrast.
